results.question: Can we place new purchase orders with Supplier J (SUP-010)?
results.text: Notice of suspension. Effective 2024-12-09 the supply agreement with Supplier J (SUP-010) is suspended following repeated quality escapes. No new purchase orders may be placed with this supplier until procurement management lifts the suspension in writing. Open orders continue to be received and inspected under the receiving SOP. [S1]

results.text: Orders above USD 15,000 require procurement manager approval. [S1]

results.question: Above what order value is finance approval also required?
results.text: Orders above USD 75,000 additionally require finance approval. [S1]

results.question: Above what order value is manager approval required for deliveries to the East region?
results.text: The sources disagree. POL-APPROVAL-R3 v1: "Orders delivered to the East region require procurement manager approval above USD 12,000." [S1] vs POL-APPROVAL v2: "Orders above USD 15,000 require procurement manager approval." [S2]. Both documents are in force; confirm with procurement management before acting.
